rationales: The nucleolus makes rRNA and assembles ribosomal subunits.
A nucleoid is the region containing prokaryotic DNA, not where ribosomes are synthesized.
The endoplasmic reticulum may bear ribosomes but does not synthesize them.
Chromatin is DNA with associated proteins, not the site of ribosome synthesis.
Bacteria are prokaryotes and do not undergo mitosis.
Germ cells typically undergo meiosis to produce gametes.
Prokaryotic cells divide by binary fission rather than mitosis.
Mitosis is the division process commonly associated with somatic cells.
An activator increases enzyme activity but is not the molecule the enzyme acts on.
An inhibitor decreases enzyme activity but is not the molecule the enzyme acts on.
A substrate is the molecule on which an enzyme acts.
Products are formed as a result of the enzyme-catalysed reaction.
Albumin is a plasma protein that helps maintain osmotic pressure, not clotting.
An antigen can trigger an immune response but is not the blood-clotting protein asked for.
Fibrinogen is converted into fibrin during blood clotting.
Haemoglobin transports oxygen in red blood cells.
C₂H₄O₂ is the formula of acetic acid, not lactic acid.
C₃H₆O₃ is the molecular formula of lactic acid.
C₆H₁₂O₆ is the formula of glucose.
C₆H₂₂O₁₁ is not the formula of lactic acid.
Energy is released when the terminal phosphate bond, a P–P bond, is hydrolysed.
A C–H bond is not the high-energy phosphate bond of ATP.
A C–N bond is not the bond associated with ATP’s readily released energy.
A C–O bond is not the high-energy phosphate bond of ATP.
The liver does not convert ammonia into an amino acid as its main detoxification route.
Acetic acid is not the less toxic nitrogenous waste produced from ammonia by the liver.
The liver converts toxic ammonia into the less toxic compound urea.
Bile juice aids digestion and is not the product formed from ammonia.
2.8 m is longer than the textbook length given for the jejunum.
2.7 m is longer than the textbook length given for the jejunum.
2.5 m is not the stated textbook length for the jejunum.
The jejunum is about 2.4 m long.
Parasitology is the study of parasites.
Zoology is the study of animals in general.
Entomology is the study of insects.
Ecology is the study of relationships between organisms and their environment.
Jabir Bin Hayan is known as a founder of chemistry, not medicine.
Bu Ali Sina (Avicenna) is honoured as a founder of medicine.
Abdus Salam was a physicist, not the founder of medicine.
E. Chattian is not the person honoured as the founder of medicine.
“Mala” does not mean good; it means bad.
“Mala” means bad.
“Mala” does not mean water.
“Mala” does not mean stagnant.
Caesalpino called his fifteen plant groups genera, not classes.
Species are smaller taxonomic units than the groups described here.
Caesalpino divided plants into fifteen groups called genera.
Order is not the name given to Caesalpino’s fifteen groups.
A photograph is a general image and not the specific term for a microscope-produced image.
A photograph taken through a microscope is called a micrograph.
A telegraph is a communication system, not a microscope image.
A cardiograph records or depicts heart activity, not a microscope image.
Spindle fibres begin to form during prophase.
Anaphase is when chromatids separate and move along the spindle fibres.
By metaphase, spindle fibres are already formed and attached to chromosomes.
Telophase occurs as the spindle breaks down and new nuclei form.
Lipase breaks down fats, not protein stains.
Amylase breaks down starch, not protein stains.
Pepsin digests proteins in the stomach but is not the enzyme used in detergents for protein stains.
Protease enzymes break down proteins and are used to remove protein stains from clothes.
